report.method: Read actual indexed lowest cathedral contact faces, actual generated static support triangles (including its stone footing) and actual indexed domestic bottom faces. No model/LOD/state/camera/network mutation. Contact-face overlaps are narrower than a bounding-box guess; this is not all future-state/road/collision or artistic proof.
report.planningScope: Actual current lowest contact faces against rendered supports, river and domestic faces. Zero translation; scene transforms unchanged.

retainingSupport.method: Read the large actual flat stone-support faces at the cathedral base level; compare their full indexed face area with actual river faces. No inferred source rectangle.
